_: ONE FILE, TWO USES. Every entry in `tokens` becomes a CSS custom property that DRIVES the mockup's layout; the matching entry in `labels` is substituted into the {{SPEC:…}} placeholders that ANNOTATE the -spec image. A reference image and the dimensions printed on it therefore cannot disagree. Values that already exist in the app are named in `labels` so the contract can be read against the code.

reference._note: These are CONTENT REGION widths — the white teaching surface inside its padding — not viewport widths. 1152 is what a 1536px viewport gives with the navigation rail open; 382 is a 414px handset; 980 is a laptop with the rail open, chosen because it is below the paired-visual floor and above the two-track floor.

labels.promptRail: PROMPT TRACK · 36% of the content region (34–38%) · never narrower than 300px · no fill, no box: the track is a position
labels.solutionRail: SOLUTION TRACK · the remainder · never narrower than 420px · prose keeps its own reading measure
labels.topAlign: TRACKS ALIGN AT THE TOP. Neither track is stretched to the other's height.
labels.answerAlign: ANSWER aligns to the solution's content origin — the same left edge as the numbered steps
labels.mobileOrder: MOBILE ORDER · title → question → worked solution → answer → what this shows · all left aligned
labels.rowGeometry: EVERY ROW IS THE SAME ROW. Same tracks, same gap, same rule — at two examples, three, or six.
labels.rowSeparator: A hairline between rows belongs to the sequence, not to an example
labels.sequenceFooter: THE SYNTHESIS follows the whole sequence at the full content width
labels.sharedFigure: SHARED VISUAL · at least 340 × 255px, at its authored equal-unit scale, longer side bounded at 720px
labels.pairedSwitch: THREE COLUMNS are legal only while 300 + 40 + 340 + 40 + 300 = 1020px is available AND neither case runs past the shared visual. Otherwise the family changes RESPONSIVE STATE — it never squeezes the plane.
labels.pairedTwoRow: TWO-ROW STATE · the cases share one row, the shared visual takes the full content region beneath them
labels.pairedNarrow: NARROW ORDER · case A → case B → shared visual → why the two agree
labels.figureRail: GRAPH REGION · the plane at its natural size, left aligned in its region — never centred in the page, never grown to fill it
labels.interpRail: INTERPRETATION RAIL · capped at a 620px reading measure, top aligned with the graph · no divider: a full-height rule beside a 720px plane would make the two a box pair
labels.visualCheckSwitch: STACK graph → interpretation when the content region < 340 + 40 + 300 = 680px
labels.statesBar: LOCAL STATES are the composition's own pagination — each state gets the composition its content needs
labels.figureScale: SCALE POLICY · one authored x-unit and one authored y-unit render at the same length. Width, height, stacking and scrolling are how a composition adapts; the plane's proportions are not.

mockups.name: 07-pairedvisual-narrow

mockups.name: 08-visualcheck-workings
mockups.caption: The algebra reaches its answer without scrolling past a full-height plane.
